evidence.quote: ruled on where reaction delivery belongs

observations.why: A completed ruling is framed as an act already done, so attention sits on the past and the settled actual.

evidence.quote: we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person

observations.why: A standing routing principle stated in present tense, generalized over every reaction, person, and run.

evidence.quote: a skill that misses the close waits for the next run

observations.why: Describes a general future sequence (what happens when a skill misses the close) rather than a particular event.
